adql: SELECT d.oid,d.measurement_id,d.mjd,d.band,p.visit,d.ra,d.dec,p.psfflux,p.psffluxerr,p.ssobjectid,p.diaobjectid,p.isdipole,p.glint_trail,p.psfflux_flag,p.pixelflags_edge,p.pixelflags_crcenter,p.pixelflags_saturatedcenter,p.pixelflags_streakcenter,p.pixelflags_injectedcenter,p.pixelflags_injected_templatecenter FROM alerce_tap.detection AS d JOIN alerce_tap.lsst_detection AS p ON d.measurement_id=p.measurement_id AND p.oid=d.oid AND p.sid=d.sid JOIN alerce_tap.object AS o ON o.oid=d.oid AND o.sid=d.sid WHERE d.sid=1 AND d.mjd>=61355.000428240739 AND d.mjd<61356.000428240739 AND o.firstmjd<61345.000428240739 AND o.n_det>=3 AND p.psffluxerr>0 AND p.psfflux>=5*p.psffluxerr AND p.isnegative='False'
